name: Fleeting Fame
description: Your appearance and gear seem more impressive. You gain a +2 bonus on the next Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidate check you make before the spell expires.

name: Groundsmoke
target: One fire no larger than 5 square feet
description: Smoke from the affected small fire spreads close to the ground instead of rising; it dissipates about six inches from the fire. The source does not specify a range.

name: Shadowplay
target: Shadow of one Huge or smaller object or creature
description: While concentrating, you change the shape and movement of an existing shadow. It remains on its usual surface, cannot grow beyond its normal size, and vanishes if the object casting it is removed. A creature whose shadow is affected can resist the spell.

name: Vengeful Mount
description: An animal that fails its Will save pulls away from its rider or handler. A mounted rider must immediately make a Ride check, normally DC 10, to stay in the saddle. The material component is a riding whip or a willow switch.

name: Chalkboard
effect: Illusory chalkboard up to 10 ft. square
description: You create an opaque square illusory board between one inch and ten feet across. You can write on it with a finger, erase with your palm, and move it within range while concentrating. A sufficiently large board can provide concealment. The material component is a piece of colored chalk.

name: Dry
book: Salt and Sea Dogs: The Pirates of Tellene
description: You remove moisture from a wet creature or object without dehydrating or directly damaging it. Harmful liquids such as acid or contact poison remain. The source lists a material component but does not identify it.

name: Cleaning
description: You remove dirt, dust, cobwebs, and similar impurities from solid surfaces in the area, as though they had been washed. Contaminated liquids and permanent stains are unaffected.
